raw_snippet: On September 15, 2026, we entered into a Subscription Agreement for subscriptions in an aggregate principal amount of a minimum of $3.1 billion, comprising of $2.1 billion of unsecured convertible loan notes (the “Convertible Loan Notes”) and a further $1.0 billion of unsecured convertible loan notes or Non-Voting Shares (as applicable) that will be issued to NVIDIA (the “NVIDIA Sale”)
note: Nvidia -> Nscale pre-IPO equity (convertible notes or non-voting shares), agreed 15 Sep 2026, closing around 16 Nov 2026. Nscale Form S-1.
